hebrewText: כִּ֗י עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת֙ צִמְדֵּי כֶ֔רֶם יַעֲשׂ֖וּ בַּ֣ת אֶחָ֑ת וְ/זֶ֥רַע חֹ֖מֶר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֵיפָֽה

tokens.bdb: ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits)
hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough)
tokens.kjv: acre, couple, [idiom] together, two (donkeys), yoke (of oxen).
vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).
